Ct. 1258 (2023) Year 2023 Court Supreme Court of the United States Key Facts Petitioner Andy Warhol Foundation for the Visual Arts, Inc. (“AWF”) controls and licenses the works of deceased pop artist Andy Warhol. Respondent Lynn Goldsmith is a professional photographer who took a series of photographs of the musician Prince in 1981. In 1984, Goldsmith’s agency licensed one of the photographs to Vanity Fair for one-time use as an artist reference.
